55YEARS OLD MALE PATIENT WITH CHEIF COMPLAINT OF FEVER "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"November 30, 2022\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis is an online e-log book to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 55 year old male patient, daily labourer by occupation, resident of Narketpally, came to our hospital with cheif complaint of fever.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDate of admission:- November 27, 2022\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of present illness:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 5 days back and developed fever which is of high grade, not associated with chills and rigors, fever is nocturnal and not relieved on taking medication and developed generalized weakness and dragging type of pain of both lower limbs since 3 days and increased frequency of stools since 3 days.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of cold and cough\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of bleeding from gums\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of hematuria\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of rash\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of burning micturition\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of past illness:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EKnown case of Hypertension since 2 years and on medication\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot a known case of diabetes, tb, epilepsy.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPersonal history:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient has normal eating habit with mixed diet.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDaily routine:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient used to wake up at 6.00AM , goes to work at 9.00AM, takes breakfast at 8.00AM. Then he continues with his work, takes rice in between 1.00PM-2.00PM, dinner at 9.00PM and goes to bed by 11.00PM.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFamily history:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo significant family history.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGeneral examination:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is conscious, coherent, cooperative and well oriented to time, place and person.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo Pallor\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo Icterus\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo Clubbing\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo Lymphadenopathy\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo Edema of feet\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo Malnutrition\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo Dehydration\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EVitals:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETemperature-98.6 F\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPulse rate-72 bpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERR-14 cpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBP-160\/100 mmhg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESPO2-98% at room temperature\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EInvestigations:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EUSG abdomen\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EECG\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECBP\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
